title: Prefill: sparse MLA + prologue
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view: 18 KDA + 6 DSA + 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, ms per forward
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 baseline (INFRA 17:48, wzhao/k31ws-int b31121cf56, runs/INFRA/step_p/int-b31121c-nv-f16f8-prof; measured/20261118-1805-nvfp4-prefill.json); achievable = nvfp4_modelopt model at the same slice
gap_analysis: Family = the sparse MLA kernel only (in-step 12.24 ms = 6 DSA layers x 2.04 ms; quant/pad are counted elsewhere). Hardware floor measured on VR200 (runs/P-MLA/run4,5,10,22): every top-k KV row must be delivered into an SM once per token (19.3 GB per F16K layer); random 576 B row gather tops out at ~18-20.6 TB/s of DELIVERED bytes (TMA gather4 16 warps, 3 stages; LDG the same; multicast to a CTA pair delivers 18.7 TB/s total = 9.3 unique, aligned pitch no change, die-local KV no change). So any design that places a row in two SMs (stock 2-CTA V split) pays ~2x; one SM per token with all 96 heads and all 512 V dims is the SOL form, and TMEM (576 cols) forces the keys-on-M PV (O^T 4x96 cols). Gather alone in that structure: 0.94-1.01 ms/layer; gather + all QK/PV MMAs: 1.07-1.25 ms (no smem contention: run22). The model's 0.643 ms/layer omits the gather term (proposed model fix: sparse_mla achievable = max(MMA, F x 2048 x 576 B / 20 TB/s) = ~0.97 ms/layer at F16K -> ~5.8-6.4 ms per 6-layer slice, target ~6.4-7.0 ms; pending coordinator review). Current best kernel (h2: QK heads-on-M with Q in TMEM .ts, row-per-thread softmax over 2 WGs, PV keys-on-M with P^T in the Rubin B collector, 64-key KV stages, slot rows bulk-copied to smem, direct-store epilogue) is 2.59 ms/layer: the softmax chain (single S buffer, cross-WG barriers, P-dependent MMA issue) costs ~1.4-1.6 ms above the gather+MMA floor.
inefficiencies: Stock trtllm-gen: 2-CTA V split delivers each KV row into two SMs (~2x the delivered-bytes floor) and runs sm_100f-form (half-rate) MMAs: 2.04 ms/layer in-step
Perf model omits the per-token KV row gather (19.3 GB/layer at F16K, measured delivered-bytes cap ~20 TB/s): floor ~0.94-1.07 ms/layer vs model 0.643

h2/h3 softmax chain: with one S buffer QK(u+1) waits for S(u) to be read; both WGs barrier per subtile; PFULL waits the slowest warp; the MMA warp issues QK behind PV's wait for P (measured: P(u)->S(u+2) 2.8K clk, softmax 1.1-2.3K clk per 64-key subtile vs ~0.5K of instructions)
Split QK/PV issue warps (h3 run30/31) hang: unresolved; needed to take MMA issue off the softmax critical path
rubin_features: tcgen05 FP8 kind::f8f6f4 with the Rubin 2x-K instruction descriptor
TMEM A operands (Q, P) to stay under the SMEM operand-fetch limit
576-column exclusive TMEM allocation (2-CTA M128 folded O 256 + S + full Q in TMEM)
cta_group::2 M128 MMA pairs with TMA tile::gather4 multicast to the pair (gather each row once)
many-warp TMA gather issue (gather4 is issue-bound per warp)
oversized (>227 KiB) shared memory carveout for deeper KV rings
PDL between prologue, attention and w_uv
plan: 1. DONE floors: gather (LDG, gather4 1-16 warps, multicast pairs, aligned pitch, die-local), MMA operand fetch, gather + concurrent MMA operand reads
2. DONE model-fix evidence (sparse_mla achievable must include the delivered-bytes gather term; ~0.97 ms/layer at F16K)

3. Kernel to ~1.1 ms/layer: debug the split QK/PV issue warps in h3 (run30/31 hang), then cut the softmax per subtile (P math+stores 0.9K clk: FFMA2/ex2 emulation share, fewer cvt; publish barrier 0.4K) so the period approaches the gather (~1.0-1.1K clk per 64-key stage)
4. Dispatch (sparse_mla.supported/DISPATCH wiring exists for the old kernel; point it at the winner) once < 2.04 ms/layer at F8K and F16K; removes the 96->128 head-pad pass too
5. step_p A/B on an int-based overlay, landed-ready
